findings.title: Dahua Security Advisory - Identity authentication bypass vulnerability (SA-2021-0130)
findings.summary_md: Dahua published its security advisory on 2021-09-01 (SA ID DHCC-SA-202106-001, updated 2021-11-15) covering CVE-2021-33044 and CVE-2021-33045. The advisory confirms identity authentication bypass during login in multiple Dahua product series including IPC-HX, HUM7XXX, HX8XXX, VTO, VTH, NVR, XVR, and PTZ cameras. Affected firmware versions are those with build time before June 2021 (CVE-2021-33044) or before May 2020 (CVE-2021-33045), with corresponding fixed software versions listed for each model family.

findings.title: Bashis Full Disclosure - Dahua Authentication Bypass (CVE-2021-33044, CVE-2021-33045)
findings.summary_md: Security researcher Bashis (mcw@noemail.eu) published full disclosure on 2021-10-06 after limited disclosure on 2021-09-06. The disclosure documents two authentication bypass techniques: CVE-2021-33044 (NetKeyboard clientType trust bypass) and CVE-2021-33045 (loopback source-address spoof). Both return full administrator sessions without valid credentials. A proof-of-concept repository (DahuaConsole) and a timeline of vendor interaction from June 13 through October 6, 2021 are included.

findings.title: IPVM Report - Dahua New Critical Vulnerabilities 2021
findings.summary_md: IPVM reported on 2021-09-07 that researcher Bashis discovered new critical authentication bypass vulnerabilities in Dahua products, warning they have very high potential for mass exploitation. The article covers the initial limited disclosure on September 6, 2021 and the vendor advisory released the same day. It provides context on the severity and potential for mass attacks against unpatched Dahua cameras.

findings.title: Hunt.io - Operation CameraSwarm: Over 14,000 Dahua cameras compromised
findings.summary_md: Hunt.io published its original research blog on 2026-08-18 (held until then under TLP:AMBER after CERT notifications on 10 August 2026). The report documents a 35-day campaign (June 17 to July 22, 2026) that compromised 14,530+ Dahua IP cameras using brute-force, authentication bypass (CVE-2021-33044/CVE-2021-33045), and P2P relay abuse. It details the persistent p2pwn backdoor account, recovered 407 MB of operator files, and notes that the campaign concentrated in Ukraine and Russia.
